get.description:
Health check endpoint for load balancers and monitoring.

Returns:
    Status dictionary indicating service availability.

Return current authenticated user information.

Args:
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection.

Returns:
    UserInfo with user ID, email, organization ID and name.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 500 if unable to fetch user information.

Stream resource state changes via Server-Sent Events.

Subscribes to NATS state notifications for the authenticated tenant
and forwards them as SSE events. Each event contains the full resource
JSON after a state transition (READY, FAILED, PENDING, etc.).

The connection stays open until the client disconnects.

Returns:
    SSE stream of resource state change events.

post.description:
Upload file content for a pragma/file resource.

The file is stored in GCS and can be referenced by a pragma/file resource.
After uploading, apply the resource YAML to make it available:

```yaml
provider: pragma
resource: file
name: my-file
config:
  content_type: application/pdf
lifecycle_state: pending
```

Returns:
    FileMetadata with URL, size, checksum, and upload timestamp.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 413 if file exceeds maximum size.

get.description:
Get a signed URL for file download.

Returns a time-limited URL that can be used to download the file without
authentication. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

Returns:
    SignedUrlResponse with signed URL and expiration time.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if file not found.

Download file content.

Supports two authentication modes:
- Bearer token: Standard authenticated request
- Signed URL: Include token and expires query parameters

Returns:
    File content with appropriate content-type header.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if authentication fails.
    HTTPException: 404 if file not found.

delete.description:
Delete file content from storage.

This only deletes the file content. The pragma/file resource must be
deleted separately using the resources API.

Idempotent: Returns 204 even if file doesn't exist.

head.description:
Check if file exists.

Returns:
    200 with metadata headers if exists, 404 if not.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if file not found.

get.description:
Download file content for internal cluster use.

This endpoint is for provider access to files. It uses tenant_id from
the URL path instead of JWT authentication.

Only accessible from within the Kubernetes cluster - not exposed via
public ingress.

Args:
    tenant_id: Tenant/organization ID owning the file.
    name: File name.

Returns:
    File content with content-type from stored metadata.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if file not found.

post.description:
Register a new runtime image version.

Called by CI/CD after building and pushing a runtime image to the
container registry. Creates or updates the version record in SurrealDB.

Requires a Bearer token matching the INTERNAL_API_KEY setting.

Args:
    body: Runtime version registration payload.
    service: RuntimeVersionService for persistence.
    authorization: Bearer token from Authorization header.

Returns:
    The persisted RuntimeVersion record.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 if API key is missing or invalid.

get.description:
List all failed events for the authenticated tenant.

Returns events that failed processing after exhausting retries.
Use this endpoint to investigate failures and retry or delete events.

Returns:
    List of failed events, optionally filtered by provider.

delete.description:
Bulk delete failed events.

Requires either `?all=true` to delete all events or `?provider=x` to delete
events for a specific provider.

Returns:
    Dictionary with count of deleted events.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if neither `all=true` nor `provider` specified.

schema.title: Response Ops-Bulk Delete Dead Letter Events

get.description:
Get a single failed event by ID.

Returns:
    Failed event with error details and original payload.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if event not found.

delete.description:
Delete a single failed event.

Permanently removes the event. Idempotent - succeeds even if event doesn't exist.

post.description:
Retry a single failed event.

Requeues the event for processing and removes it from the failed events list.
The event will be processed automatically.

Returns:
    Event queued for processing.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if event not found.

Retry all failed events for the authenticated tenant.

Requeues all failed events for processing and removes them from the
failed events list. Events will be processed automatically.

Returns:
    Dictionary with count of retried events.

schema.title: Response Ops-Retry All Dead Letter Events

get.description:
List installed providers for the current tenant.

Returns installed providers for the authenticated user's organization.

Returns:
    Installed provider records.

post.description:
Install a provider from the store.

Deploys a pre-built image from the store (no build step). Creates
ProviderInstallation + tenant Provider records, activates resource schemas,
and increments the store provider's install_count.

Returns:
    The installed provider record.

delete.description:
Uninstall a provider.

Performs full cleanup: removes Kubernetes deployment, NATS resources,
schemas, database records, and decrements the store install count.

parameters.name: cascade

schema.description: Also delete tenant resources managed by this provider
schema.title: Cascade

parameters.description: Also delete tenant resources managed by this provider

post.description:
Upgrade an installed provider to a new version.

Deploys a new pre-built image via rolling Kubernetes update, replaces
resource schemas from the new version, and updates the ProviderInstallation
record with the new version.

Returns:
    The updated installed provider record.

Downgrade an installed provider to an older version.

Runs resource migrations in reverse through each version step, deploys
the target version image, and updates records.

Returns:
    The updated installed provider record.

(Re)deploy an installed provider.

Looks up the installed provider, resolves the ProviderVersion, and
deploys the pre-built image.

Returns:
    Deployment result with current state.

get.description:
Get deployment status for an installed provider.

Returns:
    Deployment result with current deployment state.

Browse/search the provider store.

Public endpoint for browsing the provider catalog. Supports text search
across name, display_name, and description, plus filtering by scope,
trust tier, and tags. Authenticated users also see their own tenant-scoped providers.

Returns:
    Paginated list of providers matching the search criteria.

Get provider details.

Public endpoint. Raises 404 if provider not found or not visible.

Returns:
    Provider record.

patch.description:
Update provider metadata (author only).

Only the provider's author (matching tenant) can update metadata.
Trust tier is not updatable via this endpoint.

Returns:
    The updated provider record.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user is not the provider author.

delete.description:
Delete a provider from the store (author only).

Cancels running builds, deletes source archives, removes all versions,
and deletes the Provider record. Does NOT clean up installations
at other tenants.

get.description:
List versions for a provider.

Public endpoint. Raises 404 if parent provider not found or not visible.
Non-authors only see PUBLISHED versions.

Returns:
    List of provider versions.

post.description:
Publish a new provider version.

Accepts a source tarball and version metadata, validates org ownership
via Clerk slug, checks for duplicate content, and triggers a build
with the latest pinned runtime version. On first publish, auto-creates
the Provider record using the provided metadata.

Returns:
    Provider version record in BUILDING state with build_id.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If version is invalid or tags JSON is malformed.
    OrgSlugMismatchError: If URL org does not match Clerk org slug.

get.description:
Check build status for a version.

If the version is still BUILDING, queries the build service for current
status and transitions the version on completion. Already-finalized
versions are returned as-is.

Returns:
    Provider version with current build/publish status.

Stream build logs for a version (author only).

Returns:
    Streaming response of build log lines.

Get detail for a specific provider version.

Public endpoint. Returns 404 if parent provider is not visible.

Returns:
    Provider version detail.

Raises:
    CatalogProviderNotFoundError: If parent provider not found or not visible.
    ProviderVersionNotFoundError: If version not found.

List available resource schemas.

Returns schemas from installed providers in the tenant namespace,
plus platform resources (e.g. pragma/secret) from the shared namespace.

Returns:
    List of resource schema responses.

List all resources.

Sensitive fields are masked by default. Pass ``reveal=true`` to return
actual values.

Returns:
    List of resources matching filters, ordered by name.

Get resource by ID.

Sensitive fields are masked by default. Pass ``reveal=true`` to return
actual values.

Returns:
    Resource with complete configuration and state.

delete.description:
Remove a resource from the graph (hard delete).

Only available for DRAFT and WAITING resources. For active resources,
use deactivate first.

Sensitive fields are masked by default in the response.

Returns:
    The deleted resource.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if resource not found.

get.description:
Get resource lifecycle status.

Returns only the lifecycle state, useful for polling without fetching full configuration.

Lifecycle states:
    - draft: Stored but not submitted for processing
    - waiting: Dependencies not yet ready
    - pending: Validated and queued for provider
    - processing: Provider is actively processing
    - ready: Successfully provisioned and operational
    - failed: Processing failed (check error field)
    - deleting: Provider teardown in progress

Returns:
    ResourceStatus with lifecycle_state and optional error message.

post.description:
Apply a resource with declarative lifecycle semantics.

Set lifecycle_state in the resource:
    - lifecycle_state="draft": Store without processing (default)
    - lifecycle_state="pending": Validate dependencies and queue for processing

Cannot set PROCESSING, READY, FAILED (system-only states).
Cannot modify resources in PENDING or PROCESSING state.

Sensitive fields are masked by default in the response. Pass ``reveal=true``
to return actual values.

Returns:
    Applied resource with timestamps and server-populated fields.

Deactivate a resource (soft delete).

Triggers provider teardown. Resource returns to DRAFT state when complete.
Only available for READY and FAILED resources.

Sensitive fields are masked by default in the response.

Returns:
    Resource in DELETING state awaiting provider teardown.

get.description:
Get logs for a resource.

Proxies log requests to the provider runtime that manages this resource.

Response modes:
    - follow=false (default): Returns a JSON array of LogEntry objects
    - follow=true: Returns an SSE stream of log events

SSE format (when follow=true):
    event: log
    data: {"timestamp": "...", "level": "info", "message": "..."}

Returns:
    List of LogEntry objects (follow=false) or SSE StreamingResponse (follow=true).

Raises:
    HTTPException: 504 on provider timeout, 502 on provider error or connection failure.

schema.description: Only return logs after this ISO timestamp
schema.title: Since

parameters.description: Only return logs after this ISO timestamp

parameters.name: tail

schema.description: Number of recent log entries to return
schema.title: Tail

parameters.description: Number of recent log entries to return

parameters.name: follow

schema.description: Stream logs in real-time via SSE
schema.title: Follow

parameters.description: Stream logs in real-time via SSE

200.description: Log entries (JSON array or SSE stream)

text/event-stream.description: SSE stream of log events when follow=true

OwnerReference.title: OwnerReference
OwnerReference.description:
Reference to a resource that owns this resource for lifecycle coordination.

Used for cascading deletes and ownership tracking. When an owner resource
is deleted, owned resources can be automatically cleaned up.

A resource can have multiple owners (rare but valid for shared resources).

Attributes:
    provider: Provider that manages the owner resource.
    resource: Resource type name.
    name: Resource instance name.

ProviderInstallationResponse.title: ProviderInstallationResponse
ProviderInstallationResponse.description:
Public-facing response model for a provider installation.

Excludes internal infrastructure fields (deployment_name, service_name,
current_image) that are not meaningful to API consumers.

    installed_version: Semver of the currently installed version.
    current_version: Version currently deployed (None if never deployed).
    upgrade_policy: Whether upgrades are applied automatically or manually.
    resource_tier: Resource allocation tier for the provider.

ProviderScope.description: Scope of a provider in the unified store.

ProviderVersion.title: ProviderVersion
ProviderVersion.description:
A published version of a provider.

Identity fields (frozen):
    provider_name: Globally unique provider name this version belongs to.
    version: Semantic version string (e.g., "1.0.0").

Build metadata:
    runtime_version: Pinned runtime version used to build the image.
    image_url: Built container image URL (set after build completes).
    source_hash: SHA-256 of the source tarball.

Provider introspection:
    schemas: Resource type schemas extracted from the provider.

State (system-managed):
    status: Build/publish lifecycle status.
    published_at: Timestamp when version was published.
    error_message: Error details when build fails.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description:
Domain model for resources with provider/resource identity and 5-state lifecycle.

Identity fields (frozen - immutable after creation):
    provider: Provider that manages this resource type.
    resource: Resource type name.
    name: Unique resource instance name.

Configuration fields (mutable):
    config: Original user-submitted resource configuration. Contains raw field
        references and dependency markers as submitted by the user.
    resolved_config: Resolved configuration with field references and dependency
        markers expanded. Contains __field_ref__ markers with resolved_value and
        dependency markers with ref data. Set when transitioning to PENDING state.
        None when resource is in DRAFT state or not yet resolved.
    dependencies: References to resources this resource depends on.
    owner_references: References to resources that own this resource for
        lifecycle coordination and cascading deletes.

Output fields (provider-managed):
    outputs: Resource outputs from provider processing.
    error: Error message when resource is in FAILED state.

Lifecycle fields (system-managed):
    lifecycle_state: Current state (DRAFT/PENDING/PROCESSING/READY/FAILED).
    pending_event_id: Event ID currently being processed (set on PROCESSING,
        cleared on READY/FAILED). Used for response idempotency validation.
    provisioned: Whether the resource was successfully created at least once.
        Used to distinguish failed creates (retry CREATE) from failed updates
        (retry UPDATE).

Versioning fields (system-managed):
    provider_version: Semver of the provider version that last processed this
        resource. Set automatically when the resource transitions to PENDING.
        None for platform resources or pre-versioning backfill.

Categorization fields (mutable):
    tags: Optional list of tags for categorization and filtering.

Inherited from PragmaModel:
    created_at: Creation timestamp (frozen).
    updated_at: Last update timestamp (mutable).
